passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: This management's discussion and analysis provides a review of the results of operations, key operating metrics and non-GAAP financial measures, and liquidity and capital resources of Block, Inc. on a historical basis and outlines the factors that have affected recent earnings, as well as those factors that may affect future earnings. The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K ("Form 10-K"). This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses fiscal 2025 compared to fiscal 2024. The comparison of the fiscal 2024 results with the fiscal 2023 results that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in the "Management's Discussion and Analysis Results of Operations" section in the Company's fiscal 2024 Annual Report within Part II, Item 7 of Form 10-K, filed on February 24, 2025. The statements in this discussion regarding our expectations of our future performance, liquidity, and capital resources; our plans, estimates, beliefs, and expectations that involve risks and uncertainties; and other non-historical statements in this discussion are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties described under Item 1A. Risk Factors and elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Our actual results may differ materially from those contained in or implied by any forward-looking statements. Overview We launched the Square ecosystem in February 2009 to enable businesses ("sellers") to accept card payments, a critical capability that had previously been inaccessible to many businesses. We have since expanded to provide sellers additional products and services and to give them access to a cohesive ecosystem of tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Similarly, with Cash App, we have built an ecosystem of financial products and services to help consumers manage their money. Cash App now provides an ecosystem of commerce solutions, financial services, and bitcoin capabilities focused on helping consumers make their money go further by enabling customers to store, send, receive, spend, invest, BNPL, borrow, or save their money. In addition, our nascent ecosystems include TIDAL as well as Bitcoin, which includes businesses such as Proto and Bitkey. In 2025, we generated gross profit of $10.4 billion, up 17% year over year. Cash App generated gross profit of $6.3 billion in 2025, up 21% year over year, primarily driven by growth in Cash App Borrow. Square generated gross profit of $3.9 billion in 2025, up 9% year over year, driven by financial solutions, most notably Square Loans. In 2025, operating income was $1.7 billion and Adjusted Operating Income was $2.1 billion, compared to operating income of $892.3 million and Adjusted Operating Income of $1.6 billion in 2024. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.3 billion compared to net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.9 billion for the same period in 2024, and Adjusted EBITDA was $3.5 billion, an increase of 14% year

In addition, in the past, following periods of volatility in the overall market and the market price of a particular company’s securities, securities class action litigation has often been instituted against these companies. Such litigation could result in substantial costs and a diversion of our management’s attention and resources. Our Class A common stock is listed to trade on more than one stock exchange, and this may result in price variations between the exchanges. Our Class A common stock is listed for trade on the NYSE and as CDIs on the ASX. Dual-listing may result in price variations between the exchanges due to a number of factors. Our Class A common stock is traded in U.S. dollars on the NYSE and our CDIs are traded in Australian Dollars on the ASX. The two exchanges also have differing vacation schedules. Differences in the trading schedules, as well as volatility in the exchange rate of the two currencies, among other factors, may result in different trading prices for our Class A common stock on the two exchanges. The convertible note hedge and warrant transactions may affect the value of our Class A common stock. credit_strengths.text: The issuer carries a net cash position, with unrestricted cash and short-term investments exceeding interest-bearing debt, so gross leverage sits well below the sector median and improved sharply year over year. This balance-sheet cushion anchors the minimal indicative financial risk profile.

Cash generation is the strongest relative metric: operating cash flow and free cash flow cover debt many times over, far above sector medians, and both improved year over year. Capital intensity is modest, so conversion of operating income into cash is high.

key_risks.text: Disclosed risk factors tie results to seller transaction volumes, consumer spending and repayment ability, and bitcoin price volatility. Cash App Borrow and Square Loans growth means credit losses on consumer and seller lending could pressure gross profit if economic conditions weaken.

Debt is tagged only as a bank line of credit, with no aggregate debt total and no tagged short-term borrowings or commercial paper, so reported debt may understate facilities. Convertible notes referenced in the risk factors are not captured in the debt figure, leaving refinancing exposure incompletely measured.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and comfortably exceeds one, but it trails the sector median, consistent with a lower-margin, payments-led mix. The absolute interest burden is small relative to operating income and cash flow, so servicing capacity is not a constraint.

Liquidity is ample: the current ratio exceeds the sector median and one, and cash dwarfs current liabilities. Free cash flow covers buybacks, but shareholder distributions absorb most free cash flow, leaving limited retained buffer for debt reduction or acquisitions.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative profile is minimal risk: net cash, low gross leverage versus the sector, and strong cash-flow coverage of debt. Operating margin improved year over year but remains below the sector median, so profitability, not leverage, is the relative weakness.

Analyst judgement: the credit should remain resilient absent a sharp deterioration in seller volumes or consumer credit. Watch convertible note maturities and buyback pace, which consume most free cash flow; the partial debt tag is a material data gap for sizing total obligations.

credit_strengths.text: 發行人持有淨現金狀況，其不受限制現金及短期投資超過計息債務，因此總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，並較去年同期大幅改善。此資產負債表緩衝支撐最低的指示性財務風險狀況。
現金產生是最強的相對指標：經營現金流及自由現金流覆蓋債務多倍，遠高於行業中位數，且兩者均較去年同期改善。資本密集度適中，因此經營溢利轉化為現金的比例高。

key_risks.text: 披露的風險因素將業績與賣方交易量、消費者支出及還款能力，以及比特幣價格波動掛鉤。Cash App Borrow及Square Loans的增長意味著消費者及賣方貸款的信貸損失可能在經濟狀況轉弱時對毛利構成壓力。
債務僅標記為銀行信貸額度，並無總債務總額，亦無標記短期借款或商業票據，因此報告債務可能低估融資額度。風險因素中提及的可換股票據並未計入債務數字，令再融資風險敞口的計量不完整。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率較去年同期改善並穩健超過一倍，但低於行業中位數，與利潤率較低、以支付為主的業務組合一致。相對於經營溢利及現金流，絕對利息負擔較小，因此償債能力並非限制。
流動性充裕：流動比率高於行業中位數及一倍，現金遠超流動負債。自由現金流覆蓋回購，但股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，留作減債或收購的保留緩衝有限。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性狀況為最低風險：淨現金、總槓桿相對行業偏低，以及強勁的現金流覆蓋債務。經營利潤率較去年同期改善但仍低於行業中位數，因此相對弱點在於盈利能力而非槓桿。
分析師判斷：在賣方交易量或消費者信貸未急劇惡化的情況下，該信貸應保持韌性。關注可換股票據到期及回購步伐，兩者消耗大部分自由現金流；部分債務標記是計量總義務的重大數據缺口。
